pro.title: Free to play. CZ Pro is optional.
pro.body: Build your team, train your riders and compete against other managers for free. CZ Pro is an optional subscription with extras such as saved filters and rider ability history across seasons.
pro.fairness: The game must be fair for everyone. You cannot pay for better riders, faster training, or better results.

person.title: Made by one person, in the open
paragraphs: I'm Dolmer, from Denmark, and I build Cycling Zone on my own. It started in 2025 as a multiplayer league in Pro Cycling Manager, run with shared documents.

I wanted a cycling manager where you don't just click through numbers, but build something up over time: strategy, development, rivalry, and the feeling of following your team from small steps to big results. So I built my own game, with its own race engine and its own riders.

In May 2026 I decided to give it a real chance and work on it seriously, hoping to make a living from it one day. The game has been in open beta since then, and players on Discord help decide what I build next.

items.q: Can I start in the middle of a season?
items.a: Yes. You can sign up at any time. Your team starts in the lowest division and races the rest of the current season.

items.q: Do I have to be online when my riders race?
items.a: No. The race engine runs every race on its own, and you can follow what happened afterwards. You pick your riders and tactics beforehand. If you haven't picked a lineup, the game picks one for you before the start.

items.q: Can I play on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Cycling Zone runs in the browser on computer, tablet and phone. There is nothing to install.
Yes. Everything you need to play is free. CZ Pro is an optional subscription with a few extras.
No. You cannot pay for better riders, faster training, or better results.
